name: icemap
description: Displays a map of Icecast listeners on a WordPress website.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build src/index.js src/block.js --output-path=build && cp src/block.css build/block.css && cp build/index.js dist/index.js && cp build/index.asset.php dist/index.asset.php
scripts.build:plugin: composer install --no-dev && npm run build && bestzip icemap.zip icemap.php includes/ dist/ build/ vendor/ composer.json README.md
